g.data-tip: HR Document Upload (S3) — Versioned S3 bucket. S3 PUT fires EventBridge → Lambda. Every version retained (never deleted). Old versions flagged inactive in DynamoDB for audit — historical policy retrievable by effective date.
g.text: ① HR Document Upload (S3 Versioned)
S3 PUT → EventBridge → Lambda · Every version retained · DynamoDB audit log
PDF policies · SOPs · Leave rules · Benefits guides

g.data-tip: Amazon Textract (Async) — StartDocumentAnalysis. Extracts text, tables, section headings, key-value pairs from native PDFs and scanned images. SNS completion triggers result Lambda. Confidence scores logged to DynamoDB. AWS equivalent of Azure Document Intelligence.
g.text: ② Amazon Textract (Async + SNS)
Text · Tables · Section headings · Key-value pairs
Confidence scores → DynamoDB · Native PDFs + scanned

g.data-tip: Structure-Aware Chunking — Headers/footers removed. Splits at section boundaries (not arbitrary token counts). 300–500 tokens per chunk, 50–80 token overlap. Prevents a policy rule being separated from its exception or condition.
g.text: ③ Clean & Structure-Aware Chunk
Section boundary splits · 300–500 tokens · 50–80 overlap
Rule never separated from its exception

g.data-tip: Metadata Enrichment — Each chunk tagged: policy name, section title, effective date, access_classification, department, page number, chunk index. Metadata drives filtered retrieval and version audit. access_classification is the security trimming key.
g.text: ④ Metadata Enrichment
policy_name · section · effective_date · access_classification · dept
access_classification = security trimming key

g.data-tip: Titan Embeddings v2 (1536-dim) → OpenSearch HNSW + BM25. Same model for BOTH ingestion and query (critical for vector space alignment). HNSW k-NN indexed in parallel with BM25 keyword fields. DynamoDB version control: old policy versions flagged inactive (never deleted).
g.text: ⑤ Titan Embeddings v2 → OpenSearch Index
1536-dim vectors · Same model as query (alignment critical)
HNSW k-NN + BM25 keyword fields indexed in parallel
DynamoDB version control · Old versions flagged inactive

g.data-tip: IAM Identity Center (SSO) — Employee authenticates. JWT contains: user_id, access_level, department. Group memberships resolve access_classification. API Gateway validates JWT on every request. No JWT = request rejected before touching any data.
g.text: ① Authenticate — IAM Identity Center (SSO)
JWT: user_id · access_level · department · group memberships
API Gateway validates JWT on every request

g.data-tip: Normalise → Embed — Lambda normalises query (expands abbreviations, resolves pronouns). Same Titan Embeddings v2 produces 1536-dim query vector in identical semantic space as the document index. Mismatched models would produce meaningless similarity scores.
g.text: ② Normalise → ③ Embed (Titan Embeddings v2)
Abbreviation expansion · Pronoun resolution · 1536-dim query vector
Identical semantic space to document index

g.data-tip: Hybrid Retrieval — OpenSearch BM25 + HNSW k-NN simultaneously. BM25 handles exact terms (leave codes, policy IDs). Vector handles semantic intent. Semantic reranker reorders top-20 candidates by true query intent alignment. More accurate than either alone.
g.text: ④ Hybrid Retrieval — OpenSearch BM25 + HNSW k-NN
BM25 exact terms + semantic k-NN simultaneously
Semantic reranker reorders top-20 by true intent

g.data-tip: Security Trimming — OpenSearch field-level security applied DURING retrieval — not post-retrieval. Unauthorised content NEVER enters the LLM context window. Implemented via OpenSearch field-level security + IAM-scoped roles. HR executives see executive-level policies; junior staff see only their access tier.
g.text: ⑤ Security Trimming — Field-Level Security DURING Retrieval
Unauthorised chunks NEVER enter LLM context · OpenSearch FLS
Not post-retrieval filtering — applied at query time

g.data-tip: Bedrock Claude 3 Sonnet (temperature 0.1) — Generates cited, grounded answer. Every factual claim requires a citation (policy name + section). Relevance threshold fallback: if top chunks score below threshold → fallback response (prevents hallucination on low-evidence queries). CloudWatch logs full interaction with correlation ID.
g.text: ⑥ Threshold Check → ⑦ Bedrock Claude 3 Sonnet
Temperature 0.1 · Citation required per factual claim
Relevance threshold fallback → no hallucination on weak evidence
CloudWatch: full interaction log with correlation ID
